summary: No qualifying comparable sales. All 20 base records fail at least one screen as of the 2026-08-31 cutoff: six otherwise-promising Dallas industrial trades (R8490, R6997/R2607, R9929, R8382, R7274, R7218, R4189) were re-stated to the Seattle market by executed amendments effective 2026-08-20, which control over the base extracts; the remainder fail on size (R8993 at 231,000 sf; R3387 reported in acres), unknown consideration (R8114), asset type (R8252 Office), transaction character (R2188 unallocated portfolio, R8402 minority interest, R9726 related party, R3099 listing, R8181 redevelopment), date window (R2942 closed 2024-02-10), or post-cutoff publication (R7726 published 2026-09-03). The R8490 amendment restating consideration to USD 1 (published 2026-09-10) and the R8382 unsigned draft were both excluded as later-dated/unsigned evidence, but neither would have rescued those records. Shortlist is therefore empty and no price-per-sf conclusions can be drawn from this packet.
limitations: Zero records survived screening, so no price-per-sf range, trend or market-level conclusion is supported by this evidence packet.
R8114 has null consideration, treated as unknown rather than zero; if a price were later evidenced (94,600 sf, 4.25 miles, closed 2026-05-20), it could qualify.

Seven records were excluded solely because executed amendments moved their market to Seattle; if those amendments were misapplied at the entity level or later reversed, the shortlist would change materially.
The R6997 market amendment was propagated to the duplicate record R2607 for entity FIR-SAL-95060 per the entity-update rule; no update was issued naming R2607 directly.
R7726 (Fir Point 18, 107,800 sf, 4.71 miles, closed 2026-07-22) is excluded only on publication timing (2026-09-03) and would need re-evaluation at a later cutoff.
R3387 may be a unit-labeling error rather than a genuine acreage figure; no corrected source was supplied, so it was excluded on the stated unit.
Distances, stabilization status and related-party flags are taken at face value from the extracts; no independent verification was possible under the no-external-source constraint.
No comp-grid XLSX or CSV artifact was produced: file generation is outside this direct API control and is assessed only for agent/native tracks.
